entities.summary: Janibek Alimkhanuly is a Kazakh professional boxer. He has held the World Boxing Organisation (WBO) middleweight title since 2022. He also previously held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) middleweight title from 2023 to 2026. As an amateur, he won gold medals at the 2013 World Championships, 2013 Asian Championships, and 2014 Asian Games. He also represented Kazakhstan at the 2016 Summer Olympics, losing in the quarter-finals.
